Class DynamicEnergyBudgetEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.engine.AbstractSimulationEngine
org.ether.society.engines.tier1.DynamicEnergyBudgetEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
SimulationEngineModule
public class DynamicEnergyBudgetEngine extends AbstractSimulationEngine
Standard Dynamic Energy Budget (DEB) Thermodynamic Engine.

Formalizes S.A.L.M. Kooijman's Dynamic Energy Budget theory for metabolic organisation (Kooijman 2010; Jager, Martin & Baveco 2013 DEBkiss; Nisbet et al. 2000) for cellular cohorts and trophic guilds across contiguous spatial domains.

Eliminates phenomenological carrying-capacity ceilings ($K$) and discrete starvation thresholds in favor of conserved first-principle biophysical state equations:

  1. State Separation: Structure ($V$, functional tissues requiring somatic maintenance) vs. Reserves ($E$, chemical energy pool buffering environmental shocks).
  2. The $\kappa$-Rule: Mobilized reserve flux $\dot{p}_C$ is split: fraction $\kappa$ covers somatic maintenance $\dot{p}_M$ and structure growth $\dot{p}_G$; fraction $(1 - \kappa)$ covers maturity maintenance $\dot{p}_J$ and reproduction/gestation flux $\dot{p}_R$.
  3. $C^1$ Smooth Starvation Catabolism: When reserves cannot cover somatic maintenance, structural biomass is catabolized ($\Delta V invalid input: '<' 0$), triggering a continuous actuarial hazard scaled to relative emaciation $\mu_{\text{starv}} \propto (w / w_{\text{crit}})^2$.
  4. Thermodynamic Arrhenius Temperature Coupling: Biological rate constants scale with ambient temperature via $k(T) = \exp(T_A / T_{\text{ref}} - T_A / T_{\text{kelvin}})$.

      public static double calculateArrheniusCorrection(double tempCelsius)
      Calculates the Arrhenius thermodynamic temperature correction factor: \[ k(T) = \exp\left(\frac{T_A}{T_{\text{ref}}} - \frac{T_A}{T}\right) \] bounded within physically viable biological limits $[0.05, 3.0]$.
      Parameters:
      tempCelsius - ambient temperature in $^\circ\text{C}$
      Returns:
      dimensionless Arrhenius kinetic multiplier

    • calculateFunctionalResponse

      public static double calculateFunctionalResponse(double resourceStock, double halfSat)
      Calculates Holling Type II (Michaelis-Menten) scaled functional response: \[ f(X) = \frac{X}{X + X_K} \]
      Parameters:
      resourceStock - available consumable food stock $X$
      halfSat - half-saturation constant $X_K$
      Returns:
      dimensionless ingestion saturation fraction $f \in [0, 1)$

    • supportsCellularDerivatives

      public boolean supportsCellularDerivatives()
      Executes one time-stepped Dynamic Energy Budget update for human populations across cells.

      Connects available food stocks ($E_{\text{food}}$) directly to somatic maintenance, growth, biological gestation/births, and continuous $C^1$ starvation wasting mortality.

      Parameters:
      cells - populated cell domain
      dtYears - elapsed simulation step in years ($\Delta t$)
      Returns:
      true if this engine implements SimulationEngineModule.accumulateCellularDerivatives(WorldBuffer, int, double, double, DerivativeAccumulator)
